messages:
Anya: Heads-up — sketching a 'capacity lifecycle' + trigger matrix for Dedicated. Trying to make launch criteria explicit so we don't toggle behavior post-contract. Sharing draft below, please poke.

Mike: love it. want the matrix to map to clear SLA/legal outcomes (e.g., non-preempt window).

Priya: from infra: need to know which triggers are soft (advisory) vs hard (eviction). otherwise we can't signpost behavior in code.

Anya: good point. proposal: 3 lifecycle phases (MVP, Beta, GA) with progressively stronger guarantees. MVP = reserved pools + soft burst (no hard evictions, best-effort smoothing). Beta = burst credits + controlled preemption outside business-hours. GA = contractual non-preempt windows + SLA latency targets.

Laura: Sales: customers will ask for daytime non-preempt. We should define what "business hours" means in contract (TZ aware).

ScaleBot: deploy-notif: autoscale-policy-v0.3 rolled to staging at 2023-07-08T10:12:00Z

Anya: dropping a compact trigger matrix example (pseudo-yaml):

```yaml
trigger_matrix:
  metrics:
    - reserved_utilization_percent:
        thresholds:
          - p80: 60 # advisory - recommend pre-warm
          - p95: 80 # soft-burst allowed, charge credits
          - p99: 95 # escalate -> allow short preemption if no credits
    - latency_p95_ms:
        thresholds:
          - p95: 250 # alert owners
          - p99: 500 # consider degrade/route to fallback
  actions_by_phase:
    MVP:
      p95_utilization: notify + recommend_scale
      p99_utilization: soft_burst_consume_credits
      eviction: disabled
    Beta:
      p95_utilization: auto_scale_up_if_headroom_low
      p99_utilization: soft_burst_or_preempt_offhours
      eviction: scheduled_allowed_offhours
    GA:
      p95_utilization: guaranteed_scale_path + SLO_alert
      p99_utilization: contractual_burst_credit_draw
      eviction: allowed_only_after_customer_notify
```

Mike: I like separating advisory vs enforced. can we add explicit cooldowns and smoothing windows? production noise will otherwise flip-flop.

Priya: yes — add ramp windows: min 5m ramp, 30m smoothing for autoscale down. Also need leader-election for multi-pool spills so we don't double-scale.

Anya: noted. MVP docs will call out: "no automatic eviction, 30m cooldown, hard cap per-tenant remains enforced". Beta will have optional off-hours preemption toggle.

Laura: for enterprise deals, we need 3 pieces for GA: contractual burst budget, definition of business-hours, and penalty/credit if we preempt during guaranteed window. sales must get a one-pager.

ScaleBot: incident-alert: high-burst-test detected tenant-123 using 4x baseline at 2023-07-08T11:00Z

Priya: on that tenant-123 test — does the matrix treat synthetic load differently? We should have a test-mode flag to avoid burning credits during QA.

Anya: yes, add test-mode in config: bypass billing and mark events as synthetic. Ops will whitelist test prefixes.

Mike: launch criteria checklist draft:
- MVP: reserved pools available in Console, soft-burst toggle, docs + quickstart, basic per-route telemetry
- Beta: autoscale policies live with ramp windows, burst credits tracking, preemption scheduling off-hours
- GA: contractual SLA artifacts, non-preempt windows support, tenant-level billing/credits UI, extended observability (per-tenant p95 token costs)

Priya: engineering ask: need two weeks of dogfooding with 10 tenants on staging, plus a chaos run to validate smoothing.

Laura: Sales ask: flag 3 pilot customers (one enterprise, two midsize) who will sign a pilot MSA for Beta. We should bake their requirements into acceptance criteria.

Anya: scoping tradeoffs: if we compress Beta timelines, we might ship preemption logic without UI for credits — acceptable for internal pilot, not for GA. callout for roadmap.

Priya: performance constraints: kernel selection + KV cache means cold-scale is expensive. prefer predicting and pre-warming over aggressive reactive scale-up. add pre-warm recommendation engine to Optimize backlog.

Mike: agree. product note: recommend default policy to pre-warm when p80 sustained > 10m. keeps latency SLOs intact.

ScaleBot: rollout-note: canary groups created: tenants [pilot-a, pilot-b, pilot-c] scheduled for Beta test on 2023-07-22

Anya: outstanding decisions before MVP launch:
- confirm cooldowns and smoothing defaults (Priya to propose values)
- test-mode whitelist workflow (Ops)
- contract language draft for GA non-preempt windows (Legal + Sales)
- UI scope for burst credits (minimum: view + historical consumption)

Priya: I'll push a PR with suggested defaults: ramp_up_min=30s, ramp_down_min=5m, smoothing_window=30m, prewarm_threshold_p80=10m.

Laura: I'll assemble the one-pager for Sales and iterate with Legal.

Mike: Product will add the trigger matrix to the roadmap and adjust priorities: prewarm engine (P0), Beta preemption scheduler (P1), Credits UI (P1).

Anya: thanks all. if no objections I'll lock MVP criteria by EOD Friday and open the RFC for Beta plan.

Priya: no objections, +1 to RFC.

Laura: +1.

ScaleBot: thread-closed: autoscale-policy-v0.3 -> moved to product/roadmap backlog
